Brad, saw Centrical raised its $39M Series D this month to expand globally, especially across Europe.

Scaling into new regions usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Centrical off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Brad, quick follow-up for Centrical.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, especially when you're opening new geos. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Centrical needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Centrical's reply rate likely compares to other workforce-tech teams expanding internationally. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
